market_internals.label: Market Internals

excludeTickers.reason: Dominion Energy. Column holds a constant 15 for all 1,255 sessions (distinct value count = 1) while the stock trades near $50-60. This is not a price series - the export carries some other metric under this header.
Cencora. Column runs 0.024 down to 0.0018 across the window while the stock trades near $250-300, and terminal volume collapses to ~64 shares/day. Wrong metric, not a stale price.

Bank of New York Mellon. Column runs 15.36 down to a pinned 10.2 while the stock trades near $70-100, with terminal volume of ~628 shares/day. Wrong metric. DASHBOARD_PLAYBOOK.md flags BNY as a known bad feed in a prior build.

market_internals.excludeNote: Positively identified as wrong-metric columns by magnitude against the mapped company names, not merely suspected. The playbook's documented remedy is to exclude at load time with a written reason rather than let them flow into breadth and the composite. Re-check on every refresh - a corrected file can relocate bad data instead of fixing it.
market_internals.shardZNote: 495 shards; only the default z-window ships. The focused tabs carry all four because their universes are 34-120 names.
